stories.title: Premio Nobel de Economía 2026 para Michael Woodford y Robert E. Hall

en.title: 2026 Nobel Prize in Economics awarded to Michael Woodford and Robert E. Hall
en.summary: The Swedish Academy has awarded the Nobel Prize in Economics to two scholars for their work on monetary stabilization. The prize recognizes their contributions to understanding how monetary policy maintains economic stability.

stories.title: Los estadounidenses Robert E. Hall y Michael Woodford se llevan el Nobel de Economía por estudiar los fundamentos micro en la estabilización macroeconómica

en.title: Americans Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford win Nobel Prize in Economics for studying microeconomic foundations in macroeconomic stabilization
en.summary: Two American economists have received the Nobel Prize in Economics for their research examining how microeconomic factors underpin macroeconomic stabilization efforts. Their work explores the theoretical foundations of monetary policy effectiveness.

en.title: Hispanic Heritage Day parade and political reactions live | Sánchez received with jeers and insults upon arrival at military parade

en.title: Pedro Sánchez, booed and insulted upon arrival at National Holiday march
en.summary: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez was greeted with jeers and insults by some attendees during his arrival at Madrid's National Day parade on October 12. The hostile reception continued as he greeted authorities alongside the Royal Family.

stories.title: La IA no destruye las carreras, pero borra los primeros peldaños laborales

en.title: AI does not destroy careers, but erases the first rungs of the employment ladder
en.summary: While artificial intelligence automates routine tasks and increases productivity, it eliminates entry-level positions needed for new workers to gain experience, threatening internal promotion and generational succession.
